label: First copy-output step (input = orig token 0) in very short sequences (L=3, or L=4 with certain first tokens)
explanation: Update-gate coordinate active almost entirely in the copy phase (97% of mass), concentrated at the step right after the first copy output (recall_idx 1, prev_tok <DEL>, input = original token 0; 83% of mass) and only for short sequences. For L=3 this step fires ~98% of the time and holds the largest activations (all top examples are L=3, e.g. s q q <DEL> [s]). For L=4 it depends on the first token: frequent for s,f,u,b,x,1,v (>0.7 precision), rare for a,e,g,j,k,o,r,t,w,y,z. Weaker secondary activity: recall_idx 2 in L=3 sequences (~9% mass), and t=1 after first token o (~3% mass). Almost never fires for L>=5, at the delimiter, at t=0, or in the original phase beyond t=2.
